text: minervini: "RS 91.48 leader right at the pivot." Leadership I grant. But you concede "No volume expansion (C6)": day_vol 0.88 is below average on the break, a breakout nobody bought, a hard C16 rejection; wyckoff reads the same bar as a potential upthrust. To Steenbarger's question, the volume that confirms is 1.40 or more on a new high within 5% of the pivot. On that print I support on leadership; until then I oppose.
